title: Concept: poetry.lock entry without a version
description: poetry.lock declares a locked package that records no version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a resolved version Poetry's install is keyed on whatever the environment resolves, so the lockfile stops being a record of what was audited and no version-based check can read the install at all.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through poetry.lock (pypi).
risk: Without a resolved version Poetry's install is keyed on whatever the environment resolves, so the lockfile stops being a record of what was audited and no version-based check can read the install at all.
